description: Starter hand-built prompts (~10) for retrieval eval against the MVP seed corpus. Expand toward ~120 cases; keep citation_key labels aligned with your DB.

cases.user_query: I feel heavy sorrow and cannot let go of outcomes I cannot control.
cases.notes: Non-attachment to fruits of action; self-uplift vs despair.

cases.user_query: I am anxious and afraid of what will happen next; how do I steady myself?
cases.notes: Seed 18.66 mentions fear explicitly; 6.5 on self as friend/enemy.

cases.user_query: Work demands feel endless; I obsess over results and burn out.
cases.notes: Karma yoga / action without clinging to fruits.

cases.user_query: I swing between feeling like my own worst critic and blaming others.
I keep falling short and want to lift myself without collapsing.
How do I build steady self-discipline instead of self-sabotage?
cases.notes: Theme tags include discipline on 6.5 seed.

cases.user_query: Envy makes me see others as enemies and myself as small.
What is my duty when I must act but cannot control how things turn out?
I face a moral tug-of-war between competing obligations and fear choosing wrong.
cases.notes: Duty vs surrender framing in small corpus.

cases.user_query: Family conflict makes me feel alone; I need to steady myself without degrading myself.
cases.notes: Self as friend/enemy; non-attachment to outcomes in relationships.
